ir.name: all_pairs_gap_linear_range_std_instance_cond_v5
ir.intuition: Weights pairs by objective gap scaled linearly and modulated multiplicatively by instance-level statistics including instance objective range and instance log-probability std deviation, explicitly conditioning pair weights on instance difficulty for stable and nonnegative weighting consistent across all pairs.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    eps = 1e-6
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_linear_range_std_instance_cond_v5', 'weight_family': 'gap_linear'})
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    instance_obj_range = feature_cache['instance_obj_range']
    instance_log_prob_std = feature_cache['instance_log_prob_std']
    range_safe = instance_obj_range[b_idx].clamp_min(eps)
    log_prob_std_safe = instance_log_prob_std[b_idx].clamp_min(eps)
    inv_range = 1.0 / range_safe
    inv_log_prob_std = 1.0 / log_prob_std_safe
    # Instance-stat conditioned multiplicative modulation
    instance_modulation = inv_range * inv_log_prob_std
    raw_weight = gap * instance_modulation
    weight = raw_weight.nan_to_num(nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    clamp_lo = 0.25
    clamp_hi = 4.0
    weight = weight.clamp(min=clamp_lo, max=clamp_hi)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_linear_range_std_instance_cond_v5', 'weight_family': 'gap_linear'})

ir.name: weighted_advantage_exp_margin_logsigmoid_stable_weighted_mean_loss_v4_repaired
ir.intuition: Clamp weights and normalize advantage norm with epsilon; preserve margin scaling and pairwise logsigmoid loss, avoid zero weights to ensure stable weighted mean.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
lpw=batch['log_prob_w']
lpl=batch['log_prob_l']
weight=batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
weight=clamp(weight, epsilon, None)
advantage_gap=batch['advantage_gap']
mean_adv=mean(advantage_gap)
margin=exp(clamp(abs(mean_adv), 0, 1)) - 1
norm_per_sample=norm(advantage_gap)
norm=max(mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
x_raw=(lpw - lpl) / norm
x=margin * x_raw
x=clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss=-logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted=loss * weight
loss_mean=sum(loss_weighted) / clamp(sum(weight), epsilon, None)
return loss_mean

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    epsilon = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    weight = ops.clamp(weight, epsilon, None)
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    margin = ops.sub(ops.exp(ops.clamp(ops.abs(mean_adv), 0.0, 1.0)), 1.0)
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.clamp(ops.sum(weight), epsilon, None))
    return loss_mean
